guard: unsupported native lifecycle operations refuse before inspect/adopt, and executeNativeLifecycle is the public registry entry
why: Capability refusal must happen before inspect or prepare.
At least one cell drives executeNativeLifecycle with a real registry provider and nothing injected.

mutations.name: skip capability require before mutating dispatch
mutations.replace: dispatched = ((connection[request.operation] ?? (async () => { throw new Error("missing"); })) as typeof dispatched);
mutations.expectRed: unsupported adopt is refused before inspect
mutations.cell: unsupported adopt is refused before inspect

mutations.name: allow observed-mode mutation
mutations.find:
if (MUTATING.has(request.operation) && connection.capabilities.mode === "observed")
    return { state: "unsupported", operation: request.operation };
mutations.expectRed: observed-mode adopt is refused before inspect
mutations.cell: observed-mode adopt is refused before inspect

mutations.name: return recorded native receipt without persisting it
mutations.expectRed: adopt native-effect receipt is durable in the trusted store
mutations.cell: adopt native-effect receipt is durable in the trusted store
